span.p:
Timeout Handling
1. Log timeout with logger.error
2. Discard URL from visited set
3. Activate pre-indexed Curated Reference Registry
4. Ensure sibling crawlers complete uninterrupted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HTTPStatusError (403 Forbidden / 429 Too Many Requests)
(Akamai / Cloudflare Edge Protection)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Anti-Bot Resilience
1. Rotate browser headers (User-Agent, Accept-Language)
2. Apply exponential backoff (0.3s * 2^retry)
3. If persistent, return curated benchmark dataset
4. Mark CrawlRun status as partial

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fail-Safe Scraping
1. Log warning: 'Failed to extract section'
2. Return None for missing fields without crash
3. Fall back to textual date/section regex
4. Store partial record with fda_comment flag

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Transaction Isolation
1. db.rollback() to clear poisoned session
2. Log full traceback with exc_info=True
3. Prevent cascading failure to other sources
4. Return existing cached records if present

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Graceful Degradation
1. Catch ConnectError in _route_pdf_to_extractor()
2. Log: 'PDF extractor not reachable — skipping PDF'
3. Proceed with HTML advisory text only
4. Zero impact on user response latency

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OCR Fallback Pipeline
1. PyMuPDF extracts embedded vector text if any
2. Flag extraction confidence_score < 0.5
3. Record status='partial' in ExtractionRecord
4. Include raw text stream in download files

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Structured Audit Logging
(structlog / standard logging -> CrawlRun.errors)

span.p:
Return Graceful Partial Response to User
HTTP 200 with available authority records
